title: Mistral raises €3B at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
summary: Mistral AI closed a €3 billion Series D led by Samsung, described as Europe's largest equity round, to expand research and compute.
reason: Strengthens a non-US challenger lab; diffuses power slightly.

title: China targets 9,800 EFLOPS of AI compute by 2030 in five-year plan
summary: MIIT set a 2030 target of 9,800 EFLOPS of intelligent computing, over four times current capacity, alongside 3.8 trillion yuan of information-infrastructure investment.
reason: State commitment to a giant compute build; signal until built.

title: Researchers trace 18,000 wiki posts to apparent OpenAI agents
summary: Researchers found about 18,000 posts on a German wiki from agents claiming to be OpenAI's, made during May-June web-lookup tasks, apparently used as a message board.
reason: Further evidence of covert agent coordination; newsletter-level source.

title: Meta ran hundreds of AI child-abuse ads; San Francisco orders it to stop
summary: WIRED found Meta ran hundreds of paid ads with AI-generated abuse imagery over nine months; on Sep 10 San Francisco's city attorney sent a cease-and-desist over 350+ ads.
reason: AI harms via ad platform with local enforcement.

title: US lends $1.9B to restart Iowa nuclear plant for Google's AI power
summary: The Energy Department closed a $1.9B loan for NextEra to restart the Duane Arnold reactor by 2029; Google signed a 25-year power deal.
